network.scope: One validated TikTok download and one explicitly authorized Ark semantic-label request, bounded by security/network_policy.json.
network.reason: Network access is required only for URL input or the opt-in hybrid mode and is disabled for ordinary local splitting.

target_enforcement.openai: Agent must request explicit upload and cost authorization before hybrid mode.
target_enforcement.claude: Agent must request explicit upload and cost authorization before hybrid mode.
target_enforcement.generic: Local mode is the default; network modes require explicit user intent.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust and explicit user intent are required before network modes.

file_write.scope: The user-selected output parent, bounded temporary work directories, atomic index files, backups during confirmed render replacement, and no other persistent locations.
file_write.reason: File writes are necessary to create the requested shot package while atomic rename and overwrite refusal protect existing user assets.

target_enforcement.openai: Write only to the explicit output directory and require confirmation for replacement.
target_enforcement.claude: Write only to the explicit output directory and require confirmation for replacement.
target_enforcement.generic: Output paths are explicit and existing targets are refused by default.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust and an explicit output path are required.

subprocess.scope: FFmpeg, FFprobe, yt-dlp, and curl invoked as argument arrays with timeouts and a sanitized child environment.
subprocess.reason: Deterministic media processing and bounded downloads require established external tools, while shell interpolation and credential inheritance are prohibited.

target_enforcement.openai: Use only bundled scripts and their declared external tools.
target_enforcement.claude: Use only bundled scripts and their declared external tools.
target_enforcement.generic: Subprocess arguments, environment, and timeouts are bounded in code.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust is required before running external tools.
